text_block_list.text:
Today brings me to the Arima Kinen and
the final
showdown against the Golden
Generation.
Donning the aura of a ruler,
I take the stage.
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
All are left nearly speechless in awe of
my spirit.
They manage only to utter,
"She is the mighty
king."
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Today might just become Coronation
Day of the
Centurial Overlord.
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text: Now, ladies and gentlemen! This is the finale to Origins of the Centurial Overlord!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
